# Milestone 1.4 build spec: drafts, openSession, save chip, Projects dialog

## 0. Scope
Ships (plan 1.4, decision 6): IndexedDB drafts per user holding the session and pending media bytes; one Web Lock per tab; a per-draft sync mirror; repeatable legacy import; version-driven autosave on 1.3's triggers; openSession(intent), one state machine for all 22 open paths (13 boot links, cold resume, SPA return, rejoin, kept-work Restore, File ▸ New/Open, Library template, toolbar Join, leave-collab, Song page via URL); Opening overlay and error panel; saveProject() (serialized, session-fenced); save chip (~150 px) plus Undo/Redo; Practice header with the chip; Projects dialog; per-user tutorial progress and Oracle presets; sign-out hook.
Closes: state-reload-03/06/20/24(buttons)/25/28/29, engine-hooks-01, shell-01/07/08/09/14/15/22/28(flush), ia-flows-02/18, bundle-load-02/10, collab-03, insight-03/08.
Not 1.4: cloud document/conflict UI (1.5); command registry, shortcut sheet (1.6); undo internals (1.9); asset model, buffer eviction (1.10); streaming takes (1.11d); code-split, ErrorBoundary (1.12); synth patch schema (1.13); collab state machine, y-indexeddb cleanup (1.14); lesson/practice context in drafts (1.15); primitives, native prompt/confirm removal, restyles (2.x).

## 1. Build rules (every track)
- Worktree /Users/marfizo/Documents/Full App Code/Webapp-Refactor-studio, on the branch the integrator creates for 1.4 with 1.3 committed below it. Other agents edit other files at the same time.
- Read: the plan (/Users/marfizo/.claude/plans/encapsulated-noodling-blum.md: 1.4, Integration rules, Stage A exit), this spec, CONTRACTS. Probe scripts to reuse are in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-marfizo-Documents-Full-App-Code/6b84726d-8c64-48e6-b854-4e1935acc70b/scratchpad/1.4/map/ (probeBoots, probeRoom*, storageProbe, probe-save-race, save-ui/*, verification/probe-*).
- Browser checks: http://localhost:5263 only (VITE_DEV_AUTH_BYPASS=1; window.__MA_STORE__, __MA_SYNTH_STORE__; after editor-wiring also __MA_DRAFTS__, __MA_SESSION__, __MA_CLOUD_SAVE__). Never use or start anything on 5179. Scripts and outputs go under <scratchpad>/1.4/build/<track>/. Install scripts/studio-perf/mockStudioApi.mjs on every context; never call a real API. The :5263 PartyKit host is not loopback, so every context gets a /parties/ WebSocket route that closes the socket. HMR may reload; retry a flaky check once.
- Edit only the files your track owns; new files you create are yours. Other changes go into integratorNotes as exact edits. Each contract module has one owner; others import it and never edit it.
- No git command that changes state. No pushing. Never edit scripts/studio-perf/knownLosses.json, docs/studio-perf goldens or baselines, or the frozen fixtures (persistence __tests__/fixtures/v2, v2-1.2).
- Verify as you go: npx vitest run <files>, npx eslint and npx prettier --check on changed files, npx tsc -b --pretty false at most once per stage. No new npm dependencies; fake-indexeddb 6.2.5 exists (inject new IDBFactory(); jsdom has no IndexedDB or navigator.locks).
- 1.4 adds NO keys to the main DAW store; all new state lives in small zustand stores outside it, so 1.3's field-coverage test is unaffected.
- Look: neutral (decision 3). White pill primary (#fff on #101012, rounded-full); white/10 for active; amber only for warnings; no teal, no brand yellow; Glacial; 12 px label floor; 24×24 minimum targets, 28 px default controls.
- 1.3 lands first. Re-read the 1.3 modules you use. If one differs from the CONTRACTS header, follow the code and report it.

## 2. Decisions (binding)
- E1 Storage. One IndexedDB database, 'ma-studio', opened WITHOUT a version (revert-safe), with stores drafts/bodies/media/quarantine/meta. Upgrades only add stores ('takes' and 'assets' are reserved). Writes call commit() and resolve on oncomplete; aborts are typed. Every flush uses strict durability. Model the code on src/features/admin/content/mock/persist.ts, not idbKeyValue.ts. When IndexedDB is missing or broken, a localStorage adapter takes over behind the same interface: 5 drafts per user, a 1M-character budget, no media.
- E2 Namespacing. userKey = encodeURIComponent(userId), or 'anon'. Unowned imports go to '~device'. The owner is fixed when a draft is created. The sessionStorage pointer {draftId, userKey} is ignored for another user. Tutorial progress and Oracle presets become per-user.
- E3 Lifecycle. Every opened session gets a record at once (baselining). Keeping marks it kept when draftHasWork, otherwise deletes it. Pristine and cloud-equal drafts are caches: hidden in Projects and pruned. hasWork = hasContent && !pristine && !cloudEqual; an unknown fingerprint counts as work. Kept work is the same record (origin 'kept'), never a copy.
- E4 Locks. One lock per open draft, 'ma-studio-draft:<id>'. At boot the tab waits up to 1500 ms; later it uses ifAvailable. When the lock is held elsewhere the tab forks: new id, origin 'fork', name '<name> (copy)', projectId cleared, toast 'This project is open in another tab — this tab has a copy'. No stealing. Without navigator.locks the tab proceeds; writeSeq compare-and-set turns a second writer into a fork.
- E5 Mirror. localStorage 'musicAtlas:daw:mirror:<userKey>:<draftId>'. It is written synchronously only on hidden, pagehide or freeze, and only when memory is ahead of the last commit. It uses the same snapshot and writeSeq as the IndexedDB write started at the same moment, with a ≤1M-character guard. It is removed once IndexedDB holds that writeSeq, and reconciled at boot without comparing clocks.
- E6 Legacy. 1.4 never writes, rewrites or deletes 'musicAtlas:daw:autosave', 'musicAtlas:daw:kept:*', 'musicAtlas:daw:unreadable:*' or 1.3's backup key. It imports them at every editor boot and whenever the Projects dialog opens, under the 'ma-studio:import' lock, deduped through a hash ledger of data. Owner of the device-wide autosave: (a) the booting user when no other user's Studio namespace exists on the device; (b) otherwise '~device' ('Found on this device'), visible to the device's users for 30 days, claimed by opening it or, in the Projects dialog, when its projectId is in the user's cloud list. Sunset: Stage A exit + 30 days, in a later milestone.
- E7 Autosave. A module-scope controller. Triggers are 1.3's registry triggers (documentVersion, local per-user and loop fields, the Oracle patch through noteSynthPatchChange). Debounce 1000 ms, maxWait 5000 ms. View-only changes ride the next write or flush. Flushes: hidden, pagehide, freeze, unmount, keeping, sign-out. Paused from switching to ready; guarded by the session generation; identical text is skipped. Quota: prune, retry once, then the chip shows an error.
- E8 Media. Bytes of pending audio clips and sampler samples (no assetId, no sourceUrl) go into the media store as soon as they appear: SHA-256, a Blob keyed `${userKey}:${mediaId}`, referenced from the draft meta. On open they are restored with one AudioBuffer per mediaId and the original bytes. Budget: 256 MiB per user; per device, min(1 GiB, 20% of quota). What can't be stored counts as mediaMissing and shows 'Audio not saved yet'. Takes and drops no longer create cloud projects (upload at once only when a projectId exists). Takes still being recorded are not crash-safe (1.11d).
- E9 openSession. One machine for every path; nothing changes before keeping.
  - Outgoing work that can't be kept refuses the open (KEEP_REFUSED text).
  - Waits time out at 15 s, prepares are abortable, a newer open supersedes an older one, and only consumed URL keys are stripped (router replace; MSP keys and utm_* stay).
  - '?seeded=1' is read as resume. '?draft=<id>' is new, and so is the UI flag '?projects=1'.
  - In-editor navigations are opened (keyed on location.key). A link while joined to a room is refused ('Leave the shared session first'). A stale room identity is cleared by any open other than resume or rejoin. Rejoin happens only when the live draft's roomId matches.
- E10 Keeping.
  - Toast 'Your previous work was kept' with Restore (primary; hidden when the new session is a room) and View (Projects).
  - A take in progress is stopped and committed first (waits up to 10 s, else refused as 'busy').
  - In-flight saves are awaited up to 10 s ('Finishing your save…'); a late result goes to the outgoing draft.
  - File ▸ New and Leave reset in place with no reload. New has no confirm.
- E11 ?project=X. GET X first. Then take the newest of this user's unlocked drafts of X that has work and no roomId:
  - when its cloud.updatedAt equals the server's updatedAt, open the draft and toast 'Opened your unsaved changes · Open saved version';
  - otherwise open the cloud copy and keep the draft, toast 'Changes on this device weren't saved — kept · View';
  - offline with such a draft, open the draft;
  - when the live session already is X and unchanged on the server, do nothing.
  1.5 replaces updatedAt with revision.
- E12 saveProject.
  - One path for menu, Cmd/Ctrl-S, chip Retry, leave and Save As. Single flight; repeats coalesce into one 'again'; Save As and leave-copy queue separately and never join a create.
  - Blurs a focused editable in .daw-root first.
  - Generation fence after every await: no setProjectId, PUT, asset stamp, baseline, saved event or collab mark across a switch. A minted id or cloud record goes to the outgoing draft through drafts.patchCloud.
  - Fingerprint and payload come from one snapshot. markDocumentBaseline runs only if the fingerprint is unchanged since that snapshot.
  - 404 on PUT: re-create under the same name, with a toast. 5xx: retry the PUT once; never auto-retry a POST. Offline: chip error, one retry on the online event.
  - Typed StudioApiError. No ids or HTTP codes reach students.
  - Toasts for File ▸ Save and Cmd-S alike: 'Project saved', plus ' — <groups> stay on this device for now' when the save was incomplete.
  - Save As switches identity only on success. Delete keeps today's behaviour: the session stays open as device-only. Native prompt and confirm stay until 2.3.
- E13 Chip.
  - data-state saved|saving|unsaved|local|error|audio-pending. Labels: 'Saved', 'Saving…', 'Unsaved', 'Saved on this device', 'Couldn't save – Retry', 'Audio not saved yet'.
  - Fixed 150 px, Glacial 12 px regular. Amber icon only for error and audio. The live region announces only Saved, Couldn't save and Audio not saved yet.
  - Subscribes to the derived enum only; at most one fingerprint check per 500 ms. Clicking the chip doesn't save; Retry is a real button.
  - Stage A home: a leading slot in the app TopRail (chip · Undo · Redo) in every view but Practice. Practice's own header shows the chip without Undo/Redo. 2.5 moves the same components into the new top bar.
- E14 Overlay and panel.
  - The overlay sits at the .daw-root level and covers every view, Practice included. It appears after 250 ms, or as a quiet dim at once during the first cold boot, and makes the editor inert once visible. Cancel after 3 s, only before keeping; 'Back to my work' during a collab host wait. It unmounts at ready.
  - The panel is a Radix alertdialog: Retry (white pill, only when retryable) and 'Back to my work'. It handles transient failures and anything after the switch.
  - Ids that name nothing stay toasts (R5).
- E15 Collab.
  - Membership means roomId, not isCollabActive: it disables New, Open, the Library template click and toolbar Join.
  - leaveRoom() runs before resetProjectState (zero Y.Doc writes).
  - Leave continues in a blank project in place.
  - The overlay's host wait replaces WaitingForSessionModal. LeaveSavePrompt and KickedModal mount at the DawApp root.
  - y-indexeddb cleanup is 1.14's.
- E16 Projects dialog.
  - 'Projects', about 560×min(560, 100vh−64), with a search field.
  - Sections: 'On this device' (drafts with work, kept, copies, newer-version read-only, the open one), 'Found on this device', 'Saved to your account'.
  - Rows: Open, plus Delete for drafts (ConfirmModal). Quarantine line: 'N drafts couldn't be opened' with Download.
  - The cloud list is fetched on open and cached per user. Open is disabled in a room. No Duplicate or Rename. File ▸ Open… opens it.
- E17 Sign-out. Before signOut and hardLogout: flush the active draft (≤1 s), delete this user's reconciled mirrors and cloud-equal drafts. Unsaved drafts stay, namespaced.
- E18 No visible redesign beyond this minimal UI, built in its final home (src/daw/shell/**). The Practice header keeps its look, including the teal 'Take it to the Studio' pill, which Stage B restyles.

## 3. Architecture
- Pure storage, src/lib/studio-projects/drafts/: types, fingerprintHash and predicates (contracts); idb, draftStore, localStorageDrafts, prune (draft-store); draftLock, activeDraft, draftMirror (draft-tabs). No store, codec or React imports: the dashboard imports them.
- Editor persistence, src/daw/persistence/drafts/: legacyImport (draft-tabs); pendingMedia (draft-media); autosave, snapshot, draftSessionPort, signOutCleanup, devHandle (draft-autosave); draftStatusStore (contracts).
- Session, src/daw/session/: types, sessionStore, sessionDeps, takesInFlight (contracts); parseBootIntent, openSession, intents, openErrors, sessionNotices, useSessionBoot (open-session). openSession reaches drafts, collab, auth and navigation only through SessionDeps, which DawApp registers. That keeps it testable with fakes and lets the tracks build in parallel.
- Save, src/daw/commands/: cloudSaveStore (contracts); saveProject and lastSaved (cloud-save), over src/lib/studio-projects/api.ts.
- Shell, src/daw/shell/: topbar/* (topbar); opening/* and projects/* (session-ui).
- DawApp wires it together (editor-wiring).

## 4. openSession
**Phases**
1. waiting: owner, then the token (project, collab, rejoin), then the plan (Premium lesson). Times out at 15 s and goes to the panel.
2. validating: synchronous checks and the Premium gate (outcome upgrade), the in-room refusal.
3. preparing: every fetch or build, abortable; claim and read a draft.
4. keeping: stop and settle takes, settle saves, drafts.flushOutgoing, drafts.retireOutgoing(keep).
5. switching, synchronous:
   1. leave the room when roomId is set (unless rejoining the same room);
   2. resetProjectState('open:'+kind);
   3. resetUndoHistory;
   4. resetCloudSaveForSession;
   5. drafts.activate(claim).
6. loading: synchronous apply. A collab joiner waits for connectionStatus 'connected' with roomId = code plus one macrotask (the pull runs after the status write), at most 25 s; failure means roomId was cleared and roomError set.
7. baselining:
   1. markDocumentBaseline({savedComplete});
   2. resetUndoHistory (cancels queued captures);
   3. setLastSaved for project and draft opens;
   4. take the generation;
   5. drafts.begin(baseline).
8. ready: overlay off; strip consumed URL keys; toasts (kept, fork, notices); generation-guarded extras.

**Failure**
- Before keeping: refused. Nothing changed; release the claim; toast or panel. On a cold page, resume follows.
- After the switch: failed. Leave the room, reset, unkeep and reopen the kept draft, or stay empty with a new empty draft. Panel.

**Supersede and cancel**
- A newer open aborts an older one still waiting, validating or preparing.
- It queues behind keeping through baselining.
- During collab loading it leaves the room, and the older open resolves 'superseded'.
- Cancel works only before keeping.

**Per intent** (waits / sync validation / prepare / apply / baseline savedComplete / after ready / consumed keys)
- resume, live: owner / – / – / none (no keep, no reset) / – / rejoin when roomId is set, role ≠ owner and the live draft's roomId matches; otherwise clear the stale identity / seeded.
- resume, cold: owner / – / prepareUser, chooseResume, claim(boot) (fork when locked), read / apply, or an empty project / draftIsCloudEqual / restoreMedia, lastSaved from meta.cloud, notices, legacy keptNotice read once / seeded.
- draft: owner / – / claim, read (userKey is mine or '~device') / apply / draftIsCloudEqual / restoreMedia, lastSaved / draft.
- project: owner, token / – / GET (20 s), the E11 rule / deserializeCloudProject or apply the draft / true, or per the draft / offerChordAnalysis, lastSaved = cloudOpenedRecord, toast / project.
- new: owner / – / – / – / true / – / new.
- template: owner / hasTemplate / – / loadProjectTemplate / true / – / template.
- demo: owner / hasDemo / prepareDemo / applyDemo (drums inside, one baseline) / true / – / demo.
- tutorial: owner, plan / hasTutorial, gate / – / startTutorial / true / – / tutorial.
- song: owner / – / ensureSongContent, getSong, transposeSong(n) / seedStudioFromSong / true / – / song, transpose.
- practiceMode: owner / isPracticeMode / preparePracticeModeTrack / applyPracticeModeTrack, setPracticeSession, loop, view practice / true / – / practiceMode, practiceRoot, practiceOpen, practiceLevel.
- practiceGenre: owner / – / resolvePracticeTrack(consume false) / genre seed, practiceSession, view / true / takePracticeTrack / practiceGenre, practiceLevel, practiceSection.
- jam: owner / hasPendingJam / readPendingJam / applyJamSession (with the jam's bpm) / false / clearJamSession, offerChordAnalysis / jam.
- collab: owner, token / code regex; jamImport needs a pending jam / readPendingJam when jamImport / new: createAndJoinRoom; host: [applyJamSession] then joinRoom(code,'owner',undefined,'studio-'+code,code); joiner: joinRoomAwaitingHost (link) or joinRoomById (toolbar), then the wait / false / inviteRequested (new), clearJamSession / collab, host, jam, invite.
- rejoin: owner, token / live draft's roomId = roomId / – / joinRoomById, no keep, no reset / – / not found: _clearCollab and a notice / –.

**URL precedence:** seeded, draft, project, template, demo, tutorial, song, practiceGenre, practiceMode, collab, jam, new, resume.

**Surfaces:**
- toast: not-found, no-access, storage, busy, in-room, unreadable;
- panel: offline, server, timeout, signed-out, and every post-switch failure (session-ended, room-full, version).

**Labels:** 'Opening ‘X’…', 'Opening lesson ‘X’…', 'Building your practice track…', 'Joining session X…', 'Waiting for the host to open the session…', 'Checking your plan…', 'Signing you in…', 'Finishing your save…', 'Finishing your recording…', 'Opening your last session…'.

## 5. Drafts
**Write.** One readwrite transaction over drafts and bodies.
- Compare-and-set: the stored writeSeq must equal expectedSeq; create when it is null.
- The store sets v, writeSeq, updatedAt and writer, and keeps createdAt.
- projectId and roomId are omitted when null (so the index skips them). commit(); resolve on complete.
- Errors: QuotaExceededError → 'quota'; Unknown, InvalidState or Version errors → 'unavailable'. A failed open is retried, never cached forever. Two failures switch the page to the localStorage adapter.

**Prune.** Never prunes:
- the protected set (active, locked, pointer);
- drafts with work younger than 30 days;
- read-only (future-schema) drafts;
- quarantine.

Boot and switch remove:
- no-work drafts other than the user's newest;
- cloud-equal drafts;
- above 50, kept drafts older than 30 days;
- '~device' drafts older than 30 days;
- for users unseen for 60 days, their no-work and cloud-equal drafts;
- then gcMedia (10-minute grace).

On quota, in order (the caller retries after each step):
1. orphan media;
2. cloud-equal drafts;
3. no-work drafts;
4. the oldest kept draft older than 30 days.

**Mirror reconcile.**
- Unparseable: quarantine, then remove.
- Locked elsewhere: skip.
- No IndexedDB record: create it.
- IndexedDB writeSeq = baseSeq: CAS write.
- IndexedDB writeSeq ≥ the mirror's writeSeq: drop the mirror.
- Otherwise: a 'recovered' copy under a new id.

**Legacy import** maps each key to a draft:
- L parsed and loadable: 'migrated' the first time, 'recovered' after that.
- A future schema: a read-only draft.
- Junk: quarantine.
- This user's kept slots (and 'anon' slots → '~device'): origin 'kept' with their keptAt.
- unreadable:* and the 1.3 backup: quarantine.

Imported drafts get docFingerprint null; baseline {source 'import', reopenable false}; hasContent from the data (tracks, chordRegions, markers, notation); mediaMissing = count of assetless clips. The draft is written before the ledger, so the worst case is a duplicate, never a lost import.

**Media** (draft-media):
- Capture: watch AudioBufferStore and the tracks, debounced 200 ms.
- Bytes come from, in order: the original; the same AudioBuffer through a WeakMap; another clip with an identical buffer; otherwise Opus or WAV encoding, done once per buffer.
- Each item is checked against the budget and then put. The manifest lists stored media only.
- flushOutgoing waits for media writes for up to 3 s.

## 6. Saving and the chip
**saveCurrentProjectToCloud(token, {fence, nameOverride, mode})**, where mode is save, saveAs or asNew:
1. Create when needed. A fenced POST result is routed to the outgoing draft.
2. Upload pending media with a fenced stamp.
3. reconcileMissingAssets.
4. Take the snapshot: fingerprint hash, documentVersion, payload, and complete = !projectHoldsDocumentOnlyData().
5. PUT. Skip it when the POST already carried the snapshot and nothing was uploaded. 5xx: retry once. 404 in save mode: re-create.
6. Fenced? Route the result to the draft and stop.
7. Apply the identity (saveAs/asNew) and the conditional baseline.
8. PUT echo check: when the response carries tracks and their counts, settings keys or assetIds differ, complete=false.
9. collab _markSessionSaved; the saved event carries {projectId, generation}.

saveCurrentProjectToCloud(token, nameOverride?) stays as a deprecated wrapper until editor-wiring.

**Chip precedence:**
1. opening: show the previous state, frozen;
2. saving;
3. error, from cloud phase 'error' or a draft error 'quota'/'unavailable' (reason cloud or device);
4. audio-pending: media.missing > 0, or pendingInMemory for more than 1 s;
5. unsaved: pendingSeq > committedSeq;
6. saved: lastSaved.projectId = projectId && lastSaved.complete && (documentVersion = lastSaved.version, or the throttled hash matches);
7. local: everything else, including a pristine new project once its record exists.

Retry: cloud → saveProject({source:'chip'}); device → draftStatus.retry().

Tooltips:
- local: 'Saved in this browser. Press Ctrl+S (⌘S) to save to your account.'
- cloud error: the plain reason, plus 'Your work is saved on this device.'
- device error: 'Storage on this device is full. Save to your account, or free space in Projects.'

## 7. Track graph
| Track | After |
|---|---|
| contracts | – |
| draft-store | contracts |
| draft-tabs | contracts, draft-store |
| draft-media | contracts, draft-store |

## 8. Verification
**Unit.** Each brief lists its vitest files. check.mjs UNIT_TESTS lists the new paths and fails on a missing path.

**Round trips: R1–R7 ported** (harness track):
- Flags autosave* become draft*. Settle requires session phase 'ready', no pending draft write and no media restore in progress.
- R1: + refreshKeepsDraftId.
- R2: + undoKeptOnReturn, sameDraftOnReturn.
- R3: keep savedToast; + chipHonestAfterLegacySave (legacy + the kitchen sink reads 'local'); + R3:sameDevice (newerDraftPreferred, cloudNewerPreferred).
- R4: links + project + fileNew + libraryTemplate; + keptOnce, keptToastWithView, openedClean (jam: dirty), generationBumped.
- R5: draftUntouched, noDraftCreated, errorShown; + collab-malformed, jam-none, draft-unknown, project500 (panel); cold variants resume the tab's draft.
- R6: draftWrittenAfterSynthEdit.
- R7: draftFlushedOnClose; R7:idbStalled → mirrorWinsWhenNewer.

**New scenarios R11–R25** (scenarios track). Fast tier first, then the full tier:
- R11 crash, CDP Page.crash: fast settled; full playing, inDebounce (crashLossOnlyLastEdit).
- R12 every replaced session is kept once and reopens identically, in the page AND after a reload: fast New-menu, template, tutorial, project, Song page; full every path + sameIdReopen.
- R13 two tabs and the lock (fast).
- R14 an old tab writes the legacy key: fast simulated; full a real previous build on :5264 behind page.route.
- R15 revert (full).
- R16 quota: fast session; full media.
- R17 chip and save failures: fast offline, overlap, legacyIncomplete; full 500, 401, 404, slowEdit, paths.
- R18 Projects dialog (fast).
- R19 boot errors and the overlay: fast projectSlow, project500, practiceModeGrooveFails; full staleCompletion, params, collabStub.
- R20 Song page: fast inApp; full coldPage, seededLink.
- R21 File ▸ New in place (fast).
- R22 shared device, persona B (fast).
- R23 media: fast imported, sampler; full failedUpload, keptDraftMedia, mediaWrittenOnce.
- R24 perf: autosave while playing (full, perf.mjs).
- R25 UI smoke at 1366×655 and 1280×720 (fast).

The fast tier adds about 6 minutes on laptop. The full tier runs on both profiles, with lessons also at 1280×720.

**Expected ratchet** (both profiles):
- R1, R7, R5-cold: only context.practiceSession and context.tutorial (owned by 1.15); bufferLoaded FIXED.
- R2, R4, R5-spa, R6: 0.
- R3 legacy: unchanged (~49 document fields, 1.5). R3 document: skipped.
- R11–R25: 0 losses, every flag at its goal.

**Stage A exit mapping:**
- refresh, SPA return, tab close keep 100%: R1, R2, R7, R11;
- boots leak 0: R4 (+ collab stub, R19);
- every replaced session kept and reopened identically: R12;
- an invalid link changes nothing: R5, R19;
- lessons 8/8 premium and the free gate (lessons.mjs reads drafts and the namespaced progress key).

**Order after the build:**
1. The integrator applies integratorNotes.
2. npm run lint; npx vitest run.
3. npm run studio:check; studio:check:full --profile=laptop,chromebook; npm run verify:prod.
4. The integrator runs --update-known deliberately (renamed flags, LOSS_OWNERS: context → 1.15, R3 document fields → 1.5).
5. Owner walk-through with VITE_DEV_AUTH_BYPASS=1: demo; edit while playing; refresh; Projects reopen; two tabs; File ▸ New; Song page transposed; offline save (devtools); collab leave in two windows (partykit dev).

## 9. Risks and mitigations
- **Collab order** (an empty project pushed to peers): leaveRoom runs before reset; a test asserts the order and zero Y.Doc writes.
- **Cross-session save corruption** (verified probe): the generation fence and drafts.patchCloud; openSession awaits saves.
- **Old tabs and reverts:** frozen legacy keys, a hash ledger, a versionless database, additive upgrades. Runbook: redeploy rather than roll back past 1.4.
- **Shared Chromebooks:** userKey namespacing, owner fixed at creation, the pointer userKey check, the '~device' rule, the sign-out hook. This is isolation, not security.
- **A refresh false-forking on a slow unload:** the 1500 ms boot wait; refreshKeepsDraftId asserted.
- **Quota and best-effort eviction:** typed aborts, prune, the chip error, persist() once on Chromium. Cloud Save stays the only durable path.
- **Media gaps:** pasted clips without an original get encoded; a replaced Chops sample's buffer is freed (in-page undo silent: 1.10); takes still recording are lost (1.11d).

tracks.title: Contract modules: shared types, small stores, registries, and a 1.3 reality check
tracks.brief:
Create every [contracts] module exactly as CONTRACTS specifies. Most are types plus small real implementations.

Implementation rules:
- zustand v5 create().
- These modules may import only types (import type: CollabRole, PracticeLevel, PracticeOpenTrack, ActivitySectionId, StudioProjectSummary, AllSlices) and each other. Never src/daw/store, SessionSerializer, the codec, the synth store or React components: the Studio dashboard imports sessionStore, userScope, types and predicates.

Module details:
- userKeyOf: null, '' or undefined give 'anon'. Owner listeners run synchronously and only on a change.
- runBeforeSignOut: tasks run in parallel. A task that rejects is logged. Resolves at the timeout with the signal aborted.
- hashFingerprint: deterministic. Two FNV-1a 32-bit lanes with different seeds over UTF-16 code units, giving 'h1:' plus 16 hex. Test that equal input gives equal output, that it differs on a one-character change, and that a 50K-character input stays under a loose time bound.
- Predicates: the exact formulas in the comments.
- sessionStore: starts with phase 'idle', overlay 'none', generation 0. BUSY_PHASES = waiting through baselining. isOpening().
- sessionDeps: a newer registration replaces the old one, and the old one's unregister becomes a no-op.
- takesInFlight: a counter. whenTakesSettled resolves true at once when zero, false at the timeout.
- cloudSaveStore: resetCloudSaveForSession keeps inFlight and savedCount. whenSavesSettled resolves on inFlight reaching 0, or false at the timeout.
- draftStatusStore: zeros, media zeros, retry null.
- useProjectsDialogStore: sortBy defaults to 'recent'; close clears focusDraftId.

1.3 reality check: read the landed 1.3 code and report it precisely in integratorNotes; later tracks receive your report. Cover:
1. the saveStatusStore exports, whether documentFingerprint returns JSON or a hash, and its cost on the fixtures/v2-1.2 sessions;
2. where api.ts calls markDocumentBaseline after a cloud save (before or after the PUT), and the name and file of the D7 document-only-data predicate, if any;
3. api.ts's overlapping-save serialization (shape and names);
4. serializeSession's envelope (version 2, schema 3), and whether deserializeSession throws or returns false and whether it quarantines;
5. the module holding SESSION_SCHEMA_VERSION, and the quarantine.ts exports (prefix, backup key, functions);
6. the registry trigger subscription in useAutosave.ts (what it subscribes to, and whether it is exported);
7. whether loadProjectTemplate, deserializeCloudProject and deserializeSession bump the generation and baseline themselves;
8. what 1.3 added to DawApp;
9. any localSession.ts export that files other than DawApp, FileMenu, LibraryPanel, LeaveSavePrompt, useSongActions, newProject, StudioNewProject and useAutosave import.
If a contract import path differs, fix only that import and record it under apiChanges.

Tests: one vitest file per behavioural module. Lint, prettier, one tsc. Grep to confirm that no contracts module imports '@/daw/store'.

tracks.title: IndexedDB draft store 'ma-studio', the localStorage fallback, and prune
tracks.brief:
Implement DraftStore, getDraftStore, createDraftStore and WRITER_DOC per CONTRACTS and decisions E1 and E3. Read src/features/admin/content/mock/persist.ts first and copy its model:
- writeRecord (~600-625): put, transaction.commit?.(), resolve on oncomplete, reject on onabort with transaction.error;
- db.onversionchange closes (~740).
Do NOT reuse src/lib/local-store/idbKeyValue.ts: it resolves on request success and caches failed opens.

Opening the database:
- indexedDB.open('ma-studio') with NO version.
- On upgradeneeded, create the missing stores:
  - drafts: keyPath draftId, indexes byUser ['userKey','updatedAt'] and byUserProject ['userKey','projectId'];
  - bodies: keyPath draftId;
  - media: keyPath key, index byUser on userKey;
  - quarantine: autoIncrement keyPath id, index byUserHash ['userKey','hash'];
  - meta: keyPath key.
- If an existing database lacks a store, reopen at db.version+1 and add only what is missing. Never delete anything.
- onblocked: wait up to 2 s, then reject 'blocked'.
- A failed open is retried on the next call. After two failures, or on SecurityError, or with no indexedDB at all, the page uses the localStorage adapter. If localStorage also throws, use an adapter whose writes reject 'unavailable' and whose list returns [].
- Error mapping: QuotaExceededError (transaction or request) → 'quota'; Unknown, InvalidState and Version errors → 'unavailable'.
- Pass {durability} to db.transaction when supported.

write(): one readwrite transaction over drafts and bodies.
- Create when expectedSeq is null: 'conflict' if the record exists.
- Update: 'not-found' if the record is missing; 'conflict' if writeSeq differs from expectedSeq.
- Set writeSeq=(expectedSeq??0)+1, v:1, updatedAt=now, writer {build: __COMMIT_SHA__ or 'dev', doc: WRITER_DOC}, keep the stored createdAt, omit null projectId and roomId.
- Put the body {draftId, writeSeq, text}, commit, resolve with the stored meta.

Other methods:
- patchMeta: merges; null clears.
- list: byUser in reverse order.
- gcMedia: deletes the user's media no draft references (for '~device', the '~device' drafts) and older than the grace period.
- quarantine: deduped by (userKey, hash).
- usage: sums body characters and media bytes.

prune() follows spec section 5 exactly.
- Never prune: the protect set; drafts with work younger than 30 days; read-only drafts; quarantine.
- 'boot' and 'switch': no-work drafts except the user's newest; cloud-equal drafts; above 50, kept drafts older than 30 days; '~device' drafts older than 30 days; users unseen for 60 days (meta 'user:<key>' lastSeenAt): their no-work and cloud-equal drafts; then gcMedia.
- 'quota': orphan media (grace 0), cloud-equal, no-work, then the single oldest kept draft older than 30 days per call.
- 'sign-out': this user's cloud-equal drafts, then gcMedia.

localStorage adapter:
- Keys musicAtlas:daw:draft:<userKey>:<draftId> = {meta, text}, and musicAtlas:daw:draftmeta:<key>.
- Quarantine under 1.3's unreadable prefix, namespaced as <userKey>:<hash>.
- No media.
- Caps: 5 per user and 1,000,000 characters overall, trimming the oldest unprotected drafts without work first.
- When storage is full, copy the probe-and-drop logic of today's src/lib/studio-projects/localSession.ts setItemMakingRoom/hasRoomFor (lines 27-112; editor-wiring deletes that file), dropping only no-work or cloud-equal drafts. Otherwise reject 'quota'. CAS by re-reading.
- Allowed imports: types, predicates, fingerprintHash, userScope.

Tests (vitest; new IDBFactory() from fake-indexeddb per test, as persistIndexedDb.test.ts does):
- CRUD, CAS conflict and not-found, createdAt kept, the injected clock, newest-first per user, two users isolated, null projectId left out of the index, patchMeta clearing;
- a database created by a fake later build at version 3 with an extra store still opens and keeps that store; a database missing 'media' gets it through a +1 upgrade; versionchange from another connection closes ours and the next call reopens;
- quota through a wrapped factory whose transaction aborts with a QuotaExceededError DOMException: kind 'quota', previous record intact;
- media idempotent; GC grace and references; quarantine dedupe;
- every prune rule and every never-rule;
- the same parameterized CRUD/CAS/list/prune suite against the localStorage adapter, plus its caps and a full Storage stub;
- the fallback when indexedDB is undefined.

Browser check on :5263, throwaway context:
1. await import('/src/lib/studio-projects/drafts/draftStore.ts'); write, list and remove a record.
2. indexedDB.databases() lists ma-studio, which has the 5 stores.
3. CDP Storage.overrideQuotaForOrigin with about 64 KB, then a 512 KB write: rejects kind 'quota'. Reset the override.

ownerQuestions: You mentioned $172 of cloud session credits. Cloud sessions can't reach this worktree's uncommitted 1.3/1.4 code or localhost:5263, and your rule is no push before your review. Default: run the build locally. If you approve pushing a private WIP branch, only the pure unit tracks (contracts, draft-store, draft-tabs, draft-media, entry seeds, cloud-save unit tests) could run in the cloud; the UI, wiring and harness tracks stay local.

Save chip placement in Stage A. Default: a leading slot in the app TopRail (chip · Undo · Redo), with no TransportBar reflow; 2.5 moves the same components into the new top bar. Alternative: pull 2.5's zoning into the TransportBar now, a visible redesign.
Practice view. Default: the chip in Practice's own header (no Undo/Redo, since Cmd+Z is off there), and the TopRail slot empty in Practice. The teal 'Take it to the Studio' pill stays until Stage B.

Who owns the pre-1.4 device-wide autosave on a shared Chromebook? Default: the booting user when no other user's Studio data is on the device. Otherwise it goes to a 'Found on this device' group every user on the device sees for 30 days, claimed by opening it, or automatically when its project is in that user's account. Alternative: whoever boots first.

Sign-out on shared devices. Default: flush the open draft; delete that user's drafts equal to the cloud copy and their reconciled mirrors; keep unsaved drafts, namespaced and hidden from others. For users not seen for 60 days, delete only their no-work and cloud-equal drafts. Should unsaved drafts ever be deleted automatically?

A second tab opening a draft that is already open elsewhere. Default: fork a copy named '<name> (copy)' with the cloud link cleared, so it can't overwrite, with a toast. No lock stealing. Alternative: keep the cloud link (last save wins until 1.5).

Legacy keys. Default: 1.4 never writes or deletes 'musicAtlas:daw:autosave', the kept slots or the unreadable entries. It imports them by content hash at every boot until Stage A exit + 30 days. Deploy runbook: redeploy rather than roll back past 1.4. OK?

A take or Chops drop in a never-saved project. Default: no longer creates a cloud project silently. The bytes stay in the device draft and upload at the first Save. A project that already has a cloud id still uploads at once.

Before 1.5, after Save of a project with chords, notation, markers, metre, mastering or clip lengths. Default: the chip reads 'Saved on this device' and the toast says 'Project saved — chord symbols and notation stay on this device for now'. Alternative: pull 1.5's interim settings.projectDoc forward.

Save feedback. Default: both File ▸ Save and Ctrl/⌘S show the 'Project saved' toast (Cmd-S is silent today), and the chip updates. That keeps the R3 check. Alternative: chip only, with a toast only for Save As and errors.

A project deleted elsewhere (PUT 404). Default: re-create it under the same name, with a toast. File ▸ Delete of the open project keeps today's behaviour: the session stays open as device-only work. Alternative: delete its draft too and open a blank project.
Keep window.prompt (Save As) and window.confirm (Delete) until 2.3, which owns the Prompt primitive? Default yes. The Projects dialog uses the existing ConfirmModal.
Projects dialog actions in 1.4. Default: Open for drafts and cloud projects, Delete (with confirm) for device drafts only. No Duplicate or Rename until 1.5/2.3.

?project=X when this device has unsaved changes to X. Default (until 1.5's revision): open the device draft if the cloud copy hasn't changed since (updatedAt rule), with 'Open saved version'. Otherwise open the cloud copy and keep the draft, with a toast. Offline: open the draft.

Opening something while recording. Default: stop and commit the take first (waits up to 10 s; if it still hasn't finished, say 'Finishing your recording, try again'). Saves in flight are finished first (up to 10 s).
Leaving a collab session. Default for 1.4: continue in a new blank project in place (no reload), with the session's work kept as a draft. 1.14 may switch to reopening the pre-session draft.
A link while you are joined to a room (no producer today). Default: refused with 'Leave the shared session first'. A stale room identity left after leaving the editor is cleared by any link.

Media storage. Default budget: 256 MiB per user and min(1 GiB, 20% of quota) per device. Call navigator.storage.persist() once, on Chromium only (no prompt there). Beyond the budget, the chip says 'Audio not saved yet'.

Per-user device stores. Default: Oracle user presets copy the device list into each user's namespace on first use (nothing lost). Tutorial completion badges move over only on a device with a single known Studio user; otherwise they start empty.

Opening overlay. Default: appears after 250 ms; a quiet dim at once on the first cold load; blocks input once visible; Cancel after 3 s while nothing has changed yet. Invalid links stay a toast; transient failures get the panel with Retry.
Kept-work toast. Default: 'Your previous work was kept' with Restore (primary) and View (opens Projects). No Restore while in a shared session.

Shipping. Default: one merge-commit PR for 1.4 after the full tier passes on both profiles. A flag that switches between the old autosave and drafts would double the persistence paths. Alternative: two PRs (storage, autosave and openSession, then UI).

Chip wording on Guest or shared Chromebooks, where storage can be wiped at sign-out. Default: keep 'Saved on this device' with the tooltip 'Saved in this browser. Press Ctrl+S to save to your account.'

For Ryan (music-atlas-api), to confirm: (a) track settings stored verbatim with unknown keys; (b) project returns stored; (c) the PUT response echoes tracks and settings; (d) DELETE reclaims only assets no other saved project uses; (e) cross-project asset references are allowed; (f) updatedAt changes only on POST/PUT; (g) the body size limit. Default: assume a, c, d, e, f; 1.4 checks the PUT echo at runtime and marks the save incomplete on a mismatch.
